entries.ro: Futu-i, nu pot mânca porcăria asta.

entries.en: Hey, you chose it. Mine was fine.
entries.ro: Hei, tu ai ales-o. A mea a fost OK.

entries.en: Yeah, well, you'd eat anything, wouldn't you?
entries.ro: Da, păi, ai mânca orice, nu?

entries.en: Sure, I guess, except... asparagus. I don't like asparagus.
entries.ro: Sigur, cred, mai puțin sparanghelul. Nu-mi place, gata.

entries.en: Oh really? When's the last time you saw asparagus?!
entries.ro: A, da? Când ai mai văzut tu sparanghel?!

entries.en: What else're you not a fan of, hm? White truffles?
entries.ro: Ce altceva nu-ți place, hm? Trufe albe?

entries.en: I dunno... I just know I don't like asparagus. What's wrong with that?
entries.ro: Habar n-am... știu doar că nu-mi place sparanghelul. Ce-i rău în asta?
